subject: Re: Flowmingo Offer Letter for Osama
latest_message:
Dear Osama,

Thank you for your patience. I understand you're looking for more clarity
on the Talent Acquisition Business Partner role, including the job
description, compensation, and where to work.

Here's a succinct overview to address your queries:

- Role: As a Talent Acquisition Business Partner, you will engage with
companies to promote Flowmingo and assist in their hiring processes. The
position is fully remote and freelance, allowing you to work from anywhere.
- Compensation: You will earn a 50% revenue share on every paid transaction
completed through your referrals. This compensation starts from the first
180 days after a company signs up via your referral link.
- Job Description: The clear job description (JD) is available in our
onboarding materials, which I can share with you if you're interested.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

*Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team*
*Mobile / WhatsApp (Support Hotline)*: (+84) 989 877
